Hello ,

I have a combination of continuous and categorical endogenous variables in my model.
I used the WLSMV estimator as recommended in the Lavaan tutorial (converted the binary categorical variable using  the "ordered" keyword).

My question is on the interpretation-Based on other papers-I understand that the regression co-efficients obtained with this estimator are as follows:

-linear regression co-efficient for continuous variables 
-probit regression co-efficient for one for the categorical variables

Is this how I should interpret the co-efficients ? 

Thank you for your help ,
Angeline
